summary: The entry point and the only package most apps import. Supply chain is strong: OIDC trusted publishing, SLSA provenance, no install scripts anywhere in the 183-package tree. The costs are 10 direct dependencies, a 54 MB install, about 135 KB gzip, and 0.x churn of roughly 30 releases per quarter.
reasoning: Publishing uses OIDC trusted publishing from a protected npm Publish environment. The publish job installs only the Changesets CLI with --ignore-scripts and publishes pre-built tarballs, so no package build runs with publishing credentials.
SLSA provenance for 0.15.31 resolves to assistant-ui/assistant-ui, workflow .github/workflows/npm-publish.yaml, ref refs/heads/main.
The full installed tree is 183 packages: 178 MIT, one ISC, one BSD-3-Clause and one 0BSD, with zero install or postinstall scripts.
React 18 and 19 are both declared and tested by a dedicated react18-weekly workflow; types are bundled.
OSV returns no advisories for any of the suite's latest versions.
Measured about 135 KB gzip for a minimal bundle of AssistantRuntimeProvider + ThreadPrimitive + useLocalRuntime, excluding React.
caveats: ESM-only. require() works on Node 22.12+ (verified on Node 24) but not on older CommonJS runtimes.
0.x versioning: 460 published versions and about 30 releases in the last 90 days. Pin exact versions and upgrade deliberately; ^0.15.x only permits patches.
10 direct dependencies including zod, zustand, radix-ui, assistant-cloud and assistant-stream.
One npm maintainer is an automation account (agentbase-bot). Publishing is gated by the GitHub environment, but the account still holds package access.
54 MB install standalone and 63 MB for the full suite; most of that is source and source maps that bundlers discard.

evidence.label: CI publish pipeline
evidence.detail: OIDC trusted publishing (id-token: write) from a protected npm Publish environment, build and publish split into separate jobs, --ignore-scripts in the publish job, actions pinned to commit SHAs.

evidence.label: SLSA provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA v1 attestation for 0.15.31: builder actions/runner/github-hosted, source assistant-ui/assistant-ui, workflow .github/workflows/npm-publish.yaml.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV package query returns no advisories for 0.15.31.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 10 direct dependencies, 183 packages installed, 54 MB standalone, 63 MB with markdown. Largest contributors: @assistant-ui/core 14 MB, zod 8 MB, react-dom 8 MB, radix-ui 6 MB.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall scripts in any of the 183 installed packages.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT. Tree is entirely permissive: 178 MIT, 1 ISC, 1 BSD-3-Clause, 1 0BSD.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 0.15.31 published 2026-10-22; commits on 2026-10-27; 12.8k stars; 26 open issues; 27 CI workflows including CodeQL.

evidence.label: Runtime behaviour
evidence.detail: ESM-only; ~135 KB gzip minimal bundle; 0.x API surface with roughly 30 releases per quarter.

evidence.label: Telemetry
evidence.detail: Cloud client and telemetry are opt-in: AssistantCloud is only re-exported and must be constructed and passed explicitly. No default network calls found; base endpoint is backend.assistant-api.com.
